mapper.select: SELECT id, name, created_at, updated_at FROM todo_templates ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, todo_template_id, title, detail, category, priority, due_date, display_order, created_at, updated_at FROM todo_template_items WHERE todo_template_id = #{todoTemplateId} ORDER BY display_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO todo_template_items (todo_template_id, title, detail, category, priority, due_date, display_order) VALUES (#{todoTemplateId}, #{title}, #{detail}, #{category}, #{priority}, #{dueDate}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE todo_templates SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
